-- ── GlobalStrings values this window uses (ref-GlobalStrings.lua, cited per line — the -- `X = X or "..."` idiom matches CastingBar.xml/CharacterFrame.xml's own convention) ──── SPELLBOOK = SPELLBOOK or "Spellbook" -- :3820 PAGE_NUMBER = PAGE_NUMBER or "Page %d" -- :2981 -- The pet tab's label AND the window title while the pet book is up. Keyed, not chosen: -- HasPetSpells()'s second return is ChrClasses.dbc field 4 ("PET"/"DEMON") and the ref -- concatenates it (`getglobal("PET_TYPE_"..token)`, ref SpellBookFrame.lua:173). PET_TYPE_PET = PET_TYPE_PET or "Pet" -- :3058 PET_TYPE_DEMON = PET_TYPE_DEMON or "Demon" -- :3057
-- ── This window's own constants (ref SpellBookFrame.lua:1-7, Benilla-prefixed where the -- ref's own name would collide with the engine's BOOKTYPE_SPELL/BOOKTYPE_PET globals — -- this file's header comment on that one deviation) ───────────────────────────────────── SPELLS_PER_PAGE = 12 MAX_SKILLLINE_TABS = 8 SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS = {}
-- ── The window: toggle (ref ToggleSpellBook, l.9-50) ───────────────────────────────────── -- Kept BARE (not Benilla-prefixed) — the addon-facing entry point, matching this -- codebase's own ToggleCharacter/ToggleQuestLog precedent. The ref's own DUPLICATED -- prev/next enable/disable (once inside the `currentPage > maxPages` clamp branch, once -- again unconditionally right after — both produce the identical end state) collapses to -- the ONE SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() call already shared by every other -- page-turn site below — a redundant-code cleanup, not a behavior change. function ToggleSpellBook(bookType) -- ref l.11-14: asking for a pet book you haven't got does NOTHING — not even close a -- spellbook that is already open. The TOGGLEPETBOOK key binding is the live caller. if bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET and not HasPetSpells() then return end local isVisible = SpellBookFrame:IsVisible() HideUIPanel(SpellBookFrame) if (not isVisible or (SpellBookFrame.bookType ~= bookType)) then SpellBookFrame.bookType = bookType ShowUIPanel(SpellBookFrame) end BenillaSpellBook_ClampPage() SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() SpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, SpellBook_GetCurrentPage())) end
-- Clamp the selected tab's page back onto range (ref's own inline logic inside -- ToggleSpellBook, l.22-26) — split out so both ToggleSpellBook and a future re-entry -- share it, rather than inlining it twice. function BenillaSpellBook_ClampPage() local currentPage, maxPages = SpellBook_GetCurrentPage() if currentPage > maxPages then SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] = maxPages BenillaUpdateSpells() end end
function SpellBookFrame_OnLoad() local frame = this frame:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") -- LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB OMITTED — this file's header comment. frame.bookType = BOOKTYPE_SPELL for i = 1, MAX_SKILLLINE_TABS do SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[i] = 1 end SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS["pet"] = 1 -- ref l.66; read by GetCurrentPage, written by nothing SpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick(1) end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_OnEvent (l.75-92), the SPELLS_CHANGED branch only (LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB -- OMITTED, header comment). function SpellBookFrame_OnEvent() local frame = this if event == "SPELLS_CHANGED" and frame:IsVisible() then SpellBookFrame_Update() SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() end end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_OnShow (l.94-105): MultiActionBar_ShowAllGrids OMITTED (header -- comment); the tab-flash UIFrameFlash call goes with LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB. -- UpdateMicroButtons is LIVE as of the micro-menu slice (MicroMenu.xml). function SpellBookFrame_OnShow() if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end SpellBookFrame_Update(1) end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_Update (l.107-164), whole. Three things happen here and they are -- easy to conflate: the skill-line strip is gated on the book TYPE (the pet book has no -- tabs at all — GetSpellTabInfo never sees it), the Spell/Pet toggle row is gated on -- HasPetSpells(), and the title + open sound fork on which book is up. function SpellBookFrame_Update(showing) if showing then SpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick(SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine) BenillaUpdateSpells() end local isPet = SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET local numSkillLineTabs = GetNumSpellTabs() for i = 1, MAX_SKILLLINE_TABS do local skillLineTab = getglobal("SpellBookSkillLineTab" .. i) if i <= numSkillLineTabs and not isPet then local name, texture = GetSpellTabInfo(i) skillLineTab:SetNormalTexture(texture) skillLineTab.tooltip = name skillLineTab:Show() skillLineTab:SetChecked(SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine == i) else skillLineTab:Hide() end end
-- ref l.108-111 + l.141-151: hide the row first, then raise exactly the tabs that -- exist. Tab 3 never appears in 1.12 (no third book) and is hidden by the template's -- own `hidden="true"`; it is kept so the anchor chain reads like the ref's. SpellBookFrameTabButton1:Hide() SpellBookFrameTabButton2:Hide() local hasPetSpells, petToken = HasPetSpells() SpellBookFrame.petTitle = nil if hasPetSpells then SpellBookFrame_SetTabType(SpellBookFrameTabButton1, BOOKTYPE_SPELL) SpellBookFrame_SetTabType(SpellBookFrameTabButton2, BOOKTYPE_PET, petToken) elseif isPet then -- The pet died/was dismissed while its book was open: the ref closes the window -- and reverts, rather than showing an empty pet page (l.147-151). HideUIPanel(SpellBookFrame) SpellBookFrame.bookType = BOOKTYPE_SPELL isPet = false end
if not isPet then SpellBookTitleText:SetText(SPELLBOOK) if showing then PlaySound("igSpellBookOpen") end else SpellBookTitleText:SetText(SpellBookFrame.petTitle) -- ref l.161: the pet book opens on the ABILITY kit, not the spellbook one. Both -- ship in the real SoundEntries.dbc. if showing then PlaySound("igAbilityOpen") end end end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_SetTabType (l.166-183). `binding` is what the tab's tooltip appends -- the bound key to (MicroButtonTooltipText); `petTitle` is set here as a side effect, -- exactly as the ref does, because this is the only place the token is in hand. function SpellBookFrame_SetTabType(tabButton, bookType, token) if bookType == BOOKTYPE_SPELL then tabButton.bookType = BOOKTYPE_SPELL tabButton:SetText(SPELLBOOK) tabButton.binding = "TOGGLESPELLBOOK" else tabButton.bookType = BOOKTYPE_PET local label = getglobal("PET_TYPE_" .. (token or "PET")) or PET_TYPE_PET tabButton:SetText(label) tabButton.binding = "TOGGLEPETBOOK" SpellBookFrame.petTitle = label end -- The tab for the book you are ON is disabled, which is also what draws it as the -- selected (Tab1-Selected) plate — the ref uses <DisabledTexture> for the "current" -- look rather than a checked state. if SpellBookFrame.bookType == bookType then tabButton:Disable() else tabButton:Enable() end tabButton:Show() end
-- The shared sparkle clock — PetActionBar.xml's own pattern, one OnUpdate for the twelve -- buttons rather than twelve: the emitters are one model and every autocasting button -- plays the same loop in step, which is what the ref's per-button Models do too. Only runs -- while the window is shown, so it costs nothing the rest of the time. function BenillaSpellBookFrame_OnUpdate(frame, elapsed) if not BenillaPetAutocast_Update then return end -- The clock advance is the pet bar's too, and SHARED rather than copied: it is the -- reference Model widget's own truncating millisecond accumulator (that file's header -- carries the bytes), and a second hand-rolled copy is exactly how the two surfaces -- would drift apart the next time it is corrected. local clockMs = BenillaPetAutocast_Advance(frame, elapsed) for i = 1, SPELLS_PER_PAGE do BenillaPetAutocast_Update(getglobal("SpellButton" .. i), clockMs) end end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_OnHide (l.186-204): MultiActionBar_HideAllGrids and the tab-flash -- cleanup OMITTED (header comment); always the spell-book close kit (no pet book to branch -- on). UpdateMicroButtons is LIVE as of the micro-menu slice (MicroMenu.xml). function SpellBookFrame_OnHide() if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end if SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then PlaySound("igAbilityClose") -- ref l.191 else PlaySound("igSpellBookClose") end end
-- UpdateSpells(): the ref's OWN global (`SpellBookFrame.lua:26/116/411/426/450` — never -- DEFINED in this session's extraction, a base-UI/C-level helper outside this file) -- transcribed here as BenillaUpdateSpells(): refresh every spell button on the current -- page (this file's own convention: explicit button params, not ambient `this`). function BenillaUpdateSpells() for i = 1, SPELLS_PER_PAGE do BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(getglobal("SpellButton" .. i)) end end
-- ── The spell button (ref SpellButton_*, l.206-404) ────────────────────────────────────── -- CRAFT_SHOW/_CLOSE/TRADE_SKILL_SHOW/_CLOSE are OMITTED (header comment: no craft or -- trade-skill window arm); SPELLS_CHANGED and SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN drive the full refresh -- (the ref's own shared branch, l.221) and CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED the checked ring. -- PET_BAR_UPDATE is LIVE (ref l.214 + l.227-231) and it is the pet page's whole repaint -- wire: the pet book's cooldowns, autocast bits and active ring all move without the BOOK -- changing, so SPELLS_CHANGED alone would leave a stale page. function SpellButton_OnLoad() local button = this button:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") button:RegisterEvent("CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED") button:RegisterEvent("SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN") button:RegisterEvent("PET_BAR_UPDATE") button:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") button:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") button.autocastable = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "AutoCastable") -- The ref's `$parentAutoCast` is a <Model> playing UI-AutoCastButton.mdx; we have no -- Model widget, so the pet bar's byte-derived sparkle emitter stands in for it -- (decision 0982 — PetActionBar.xml owns the numbers and both surfaces share them). -- Nothing to build here: that emitter pools itself lazily, on the first frame a -- button autocasts, which on this page is a pet-book spell and never a player one. BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) end
function SpellButton_OnEvent(event) local button = this if event == "SPELLS_CHANGED" or event == "SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN" then BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) elseif event == "CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED" then BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) elseif event == "PET_BAR_UPDATE" then if SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) end end end
-- ref SpellButton_UpdateSelection (l.292-306): the checked ring — `IsCurrentCast` over -- the app-resolved verdict (the ACTIVE shapeshift form's own spell — Ghost Wolf glows -- while the shaman is the wolf, a druid form likewise; the engine predicate `0x4b3600` -- deliberately has NO casting-now arm, so an ordinary cast never lights a book slot). -- The ref's out-of-tab bounds fork collapses into the one SetChecked: IsCurrentCast -- answers nil past the book's end already. function BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) local id = SpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) button:SetChecked(IsCurrentCast(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType)) end
-- ref SpellButton_OnEnter (l.235-244): the engine's SetSpell — the byte-verified spell -- line law (decision 0276: cost|range one line, casttime|cooldown one line, passives -- omit it, the $-substituted gold description; no rank column from the book — the -- verified showRank=0). function BenillaSpellButton_OnEnter(button) if not GameTooltip then return end -- engine tests load file subsets local id = SpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) if not GetSpellName(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetSpell(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) end
-- ref SpellButton_OnClick (l.263-290): the MacroFrame branch and the right-click pet -- autocast fork are both OMITTED (header comment) — shift-click always picks up (the -- ref's own "no MacroFrame visible" fallthrough), every other click casts. The -- `id > MAX_SPELLS` guard is dropped too: GetSpellName/CastSpell/PickupSpell already -- answer nil/no-op for any id past the book's real length, so the extra guard checks -- nothing a MAX_SPELLS constant would add here. function SpellButton_OnClick(drag) local button = this -- The mouse button is the ambient `arg1`, exactly as the reference reads it (l.284) — -- its XML passes nothing on OnClick and a bare `1` on the two drag slots. Only the -- `drag` falsy arm below reaches it, so the drag slots never read a stale arg1. local mouseButton = arg1 local id = SpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) button:SetChecked("false") if drag then PickupSpell(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) elseif not IsShiftKeyDown() and mouseButton and mouseButton ~= "LeftButton" and SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then -- ref l.284-285: on the PET page a non-left click flips autocast instead of -- casting. Shift still outranks it — the ref tests shift first, so a shift -- right-click on a pet spell picks it up. ToggleSpellAutocast(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- ref SpellButton_OnClick l.271-283 (LIVE since decision 0983): with the macro -- editor open a shift-click APPENDS `/cast <name>[(<rank>)]` to the body instead of -- picking the spell up — the behaviour MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE5 advertises ("Shift -- click a spell in your spellbook with the macro UI open to add it to your macro"). -- The `/cast` alias comes from the shipped strings (SLASH_CAST1), never typed here. -- -- DO NOT "FIX" THIS TO INSERT THE BARE NAME (B248, decision 1328). The whole -- `/cast` line is what 1.12.1 writes; the bare-name-at-the-cursor insert people -- remember is a LATER client's (`ChatEdit_InsertLink`). And the gate is SHIFT, -- not the mouse button: a plain right click on this page casts, same as a left one -- — pinned both ways in `ui_script::spellbook_tests`. local macroFrame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") if macroFrame and macroFrame:IsVisible() then local spellName, subSpellName = GetSpellName(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) if spellName and not IsSpellPassive(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) then local line = (SLASH_CAST1 or "/cast") .. " " .. spellName if subSpellName and string.len(subSpellName) > 0 then line = line .. "(" .. subSpellName .. ")" end BenillaMacroFrame_AddMacroLine(line) end else PickupSpell(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) end else CastSpell(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) -- ref l.288: the ring re-reads at once end end
-- ref SpellButton_UpdateButton (l.307-404): the autocast overlay/model is OMITTED -- (header comment); the cooldown sweep (l.359-365) and the checked-ring tail call are -- LIVE. Passive gates CastSpell engine-side (spellbook.rs), not here — this only grays -- the presentation. function BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) if not button:IsVisible() then return end if GameTooltip:IsOwned(button) then BenillaSpellButton_OnEnter(button) end if not SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine then SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine = 1 end local isPet = SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET local temp, tabTexture, offset, numSpells = GetSpellTabInfo(SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine) offset = offset or 0 numSpells = numSpells or 0 SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineOffset = offset local id = SpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) local name = button:GetName() local iconTexture = getglobal(name .. "IconTexture") local spellString = getglobal(name .. "SpellName") local subSpellString = getglobal(name .. "SubSpellName") local cooldown = getglobal(name .. "Cooldown") local autocastable = getglobal(name .. "AutoCastable") local highlightTexture = getglobal(name .. "Highlight") local normalTexture = getglobal(name .. "NormalTexture")
-- TWO WAYS A SLOT COMES UP EMPTY, one dress for both. Past the end of the tab the -- button also goes DEAD; a slot the book counts but has no icon for stays live and -- only puts its highlight kit back to the square. Everything else the two do — the -- five regions down, the autocast bit cleared, the ring unchecked, the button's own -- ring back to plain white — is the same blanking, and it is written once here rather -- than once per arm. -- -- ref l.328: the out-of-tab test is `(bookType ~= BOOKTYPE_PET) and ...` — the pet -- page has no tab to be out of, so a pet button past the end of the book falls to the -- no-icon arm instead and stays ENABLED. Faithful, and harmless: an enabled button -- with no spell behind it clicks into GetSpellName's nil and does nothing. local outOfTab = (not isPet) and id > (offset + numSpells) if outOfTab then button:Disable() else button:Enable() end local texture if not outOfTab then texture = GetSpellTexture(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) end if outOfTab or (not texture) or (texture == "") then iconTexture:Hide() spellString:Hide() subSpellString:Hide() cooldown:Hide() autocastable:Hide() button.autocasting = nil if not outOfTab then highlightTexture:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square") end button:SetChecked(0) normalTexture:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) return end -- The cooldown sweep + the enable-keyed icon dim (ref l.359-365): enable == 0 is an -- on-hold cooldown (Stealth/Feign Death parked until SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT) — the -- widget stays hidden (CooldownFrame_SetTimer's own gate) and the icon reads 40%. local start, duration, enable = GetSpellCooldown(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) CooldownFrame_SetTimer(cooldown, start, duration, enable) local brightness = (enable == 1) and 1.0 or 0.4 iconTexture:SetVertexColor(brightness, brightness, brightness) -- ref l.367-377: the autocast pair. `GetSpellAutocast` answers (nil, nil) for the -- player book by the engine's own short-circuit, so this needs no isPet guard — the -- overlay and the sparkle simply never come on outside the pet page. local autoCastAllowed, autoCastEnabled = GetSpellAutocast(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) if autoCastAllowed then autocastable:Show() else autocastable:Hide() end button.autocasting = autoCastEnabled local spellName, subSpellName = GetSpellName(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) local isPassive = IsSpellPassive(id, SpellBookFrame.bookType) -- A passive slot wears a whole different dress — the button ring blacked right out, -- the round passive highlight in place of the square one, and the name in the passive -- grey. Three values that always travel together, so they are chosen once and applied -- once instead of each verb appearing in both arms. local ringLevel, highlightFile, nameColor if isPassive then ringLevel, highlightFile, nameColor = 0, "Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PassiveHighlight", PASSIVE_SPELL_FONT_COLOR else ringLevel, highlightFile, nameColor = 1.0, "Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square", NORMAL_FONT_COLOR end normalTexture:SetVertexColor(ringLevel, ringLevel, ringLevel) highlightTexture:SetTexture(highlightFile) spellString:SetTextColor(nameColor.r, nameColor.g, nameColor.b) iconTexture:SetTexture(texture) spellString:SetText(spellName) subSpellString:SetText(subSpellName) if subSpellName and subSpellName ~= "" then spellString:SetPoint("LEFT", button, "RIGHT", 4, 4) else spellString:SetPoint("LEFT", button, "RIGHT", 4, 2) end iconTexture:Show() spellString:Show() subSpellString:Show() BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) -- ref l.403: every full refresh re-reads the ring end
-- ── Page turn (ref PrevPageButton_OnClick/NextPageButton_OnClick, l.406-434) ───────────── -- -- DO NOT "FIX" THE KEY (decision 1032, the standing rule from 1030). The reference writes -- `SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[selectedSkillLine]` on BOTH books, while `SpellBook_GetCurrentPage` -- reads `SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS["pet"]` for the pet one — a key nothing writes. So on the -- pet page the arrows turn nothing, the page text says a number the page does not honour, -- and the *spell* book's page counter moves behind your back. All three are the reference's -- and all three are reproduced; `SpellBook_GetSpellID`'s note is the other half. function BenillaSpellBookPrevPageButton_OnClick() local pageNum = SpellBook_GetCurrentPage() - 1 SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] = pageNum SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() SpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, pageNum)) BenillaUpdateSpells() -- ref l.414-417: the pet page re-asserts its own title, because the spell book's page -- text handler is shared and the title is not. if SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then SpellBookTitleText:SetText(SpellBookFrame.petTitle) end PlaySound("igAbiliityPageTurn") end
function BenillaSpellBookNextPageButton_OnClick() local pageNum = SpellBook_GetCurrentPage() + 1 SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] = pageNum SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() SpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, pageNum)) BenillaUpdateSpells() if SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then SpellBookTitleText:SetText(SpellBookFrame.petTitle) end PlaySound("igAbiliityPageTurn") end
-- ── The skill-line tabs (ref SpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick, l.436-457) ─────────────────── function SpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick(id) local update if not id then update = 1 id = this:GetID() end SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine = id local name, texture, offset, numSpells = GetSpellTabInfo(id) SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineOffset = offset or 0 SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineNumSpells = numSpells or 0 SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() SpellBookFrame_Update() SpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, SpellBook_GetCurrentPage())) if update then BenillaUpdateSpells() end end
-- ref SpellBook_GetSpellID (l.459-465). This is the book id the engine's own byte-verified -- seam expects verbatim (`benilla-ui/src/script/spellbook.rs`'s module doc). -- -- DO NOT "FIX" THE PET ARM (decision 1032, the standing rule from 1030). The reference's -- pet branch is a bare `return id` — no tab offset, and **no page term** — so the pet page -- always shows book entries 1..12 no matter what page number the window is displaying. A -- well-trained hunter pet can know more than twelve spells, so this is visible, and it is -- still the reference's behaviour. Its sibling quirk is in the two page-turn handlers. function SpellBook_GetSpellID(id) if SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then return id end return id + (SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineOffset or 0) + (SPELLS_PER_PAGE * ((SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] or 1) - 1)) end
-- ref SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows (l.467-479). An arrow is live exactly while the page it -- points at is a DIFFERENT page. Stated as an inequality rather than a range test on -- purpose: the pet book's arrows write a counter its own page ignores (the do-not-fix -- notes above), so a page number can sit outside 1..maxPages, and when it does BOTH arrows -- stay live — which is the reference's answer, not an accident of this spelling. function SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() local currentPage, maxPages = SpellBook_GetCurrentPage() if currentPage ~= 1 then SpellBookPrevPageButton:Enable() else SpellBookPrevPageButton:Disable() end if currentPage ~= maxPages then SpellBookNextPageButton:Enable() else SpellBookNextPageButton:Disable() end end
-- ref SpellBook_GetCurrentPage (l.481-493), both branches. `maxPages` is clamped to at -- least 1 (a defensive addition this file's own — an empty/not-yet-fed book must still -- show ONE (empty) page rather than disabling both page buttons into a currentPage=1 > -- maxPages=0 dead state). -- -- The pet branch reads `SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS["pet"]`, which is the counter NOTHING ever -- writes — see the page-turn handlers. So it is always 1, and with it `maxPages > 1` the -- Next arrow stays enabled forever on a big pet book. Reference behaviour; see the -- do-not-fix note on `SpellBook_GetSpellID`. function SpellBook_GetCurrentPage() local numPetSpells = HasPetSpells() if numPetSpells and SpellBookFrame.bookType == BOOKTYPE_PET then return SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS["pet"] or 1, max(ceil(numPetSpells / SPELLS_PER_PAGE), 1) end local currentPage = SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] or 1 local temp, texture, offset, numSpells = GetSpellTabInfo(SpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine) local maxPages = max(ceil((numSpells or 0) / SPELLS_PER_PAGE), 1) return currentPage, maxPages end

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if self.tooltip then GameTooltip:SetText(self.tooltip) GameTooltip:Show() end

GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") -- ref l.53: the label plus its bound key. MicroButtonTooltipText is MicroMenu.xml's -- (loaded before this file); nil-guarded like every other cross-file call here. if MicroButtonTooltipText then GameTooltip:SetText(MicroButtonTooltipText(self:GetText(), self.binding), 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) else GameTooltip:SetText(self:GetText(), 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end GameTooltip:Show()
